notes: The *He* of *He maketh* is the one materially contestable unit: kept with the participle the ASV renders as a finite verb (rule 17), with the `added` reading under rule 25 named in the unit note; no earlier nominal in the verse denotes God and the suffix of עִמּוֹ already holds *him*.
מָרוֹם → *high places* heads on *high* under rule 31; the copula of the verbless first clause sits on עִם under rule 49.
